div.div: The bi-encoder never sees the pair, so its number is a distance between two summaries. The cross-encoder is asked a question about a specific pair, so its number is an answer to that question — which is why a fixed threshold means something on it.

switch.text: The bi-encoder never sees the pair, so its number is a distance between two summaries. The cross-encoder is asked a question about a specific pair, so its number is an answer to that question — which is why a fixed threshold means something on it.
